description: This Java class 'DefaultDatabaseSchemaSettingsService' manages database schema version validation, creation, and updates for the Thingsboard project, including version normalization and compatibility checks.

classes.name: DefaultDatabaseSchemaSettingsService
classes.description: Service class for managing database schema versioning and validation in Thingsboard.

methods.name: validateSchemaSettings
methods.description: Validates the current database schema version against supported versions and project info.

methods.name: createSchemaSettings
methods.description: Creates initial schema settings record in the database if not present.

methods.name: updateSchemaVersion
methods.description: Updates the schema version in the database.

methods.name: getPackageSchemaVersion
methods.description: Returns the normalized package schema version.

methods.name: getDbSchemaVersion
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the database schema version from the database.
